verdicts.statement: A maximum of one copy of a backup snapshot can be created in each destination region.
verdicts.reason: The context explicitly states that only one copy of the backup snapshot can exist in each region.

verdicts.statement: A copy of a backup snapshot cannot be created in the source (local) region.
verdicts.reason: The context explicitly states that a copy of the backup snapshot cannot be created in the source (local) region.

verdicts.statement: A copied backup snapshot can later be used to restore a volume in the destination region of the copied backup snapshot.
verdicts.reason: The context states that a backup snapshot can be copied to another region and later used to restore a volume in that new region.
